questions.q: In the study of art and science, colour is generally defined as the visual effect caused by what?
options: The absorption of heat in an object.
The reflection of light off an object into the eye.
The magnetic field surrounding an object.
The amount of water contained inside an object.
questions.explain: Colour is a property of light. We see colour because objects reflect specific wavelengths of light into our eyes while absorbing others.

questions.q: Who is the English scientist credited with discovering that white daylight is made up of a spectrum of colours by passing light through a glass prism in 1666?
questions.explain: Sir Isaac Newton discovered the colour spectrum when he passed white light through a triangular glass prism, separating it into the colours of the rainbow.

questions.q: What is the common acronym used to remember the seven colours of the light spectrum (the rainbow)?
questions.explain: ROYGBIV stands for Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet, which are the visible colours of the spectrum in order of their wavelengths.
